25.original: Deliver the tulidile meat to Zarwarkur.

48.original: Well met, traveler! By the look of you, I presume you know how to hunt, yes? Would you be interested to learn how we prepare our traditional jerky?

49.original: In exchange, all I ask is that you supply the main ingredient, as my stock is running low.

50.original: For this, we will require tulidile meat. Head north of our village and look for a specimen worthy of salting!

51.original: You should be able to find tulidiles in their natural habitat just north of here. Best of luck!

53.original: Oooh, now there's a beautiful slab! Barely any fat to trim. A quick coating of salt and we should be well on our way to some mouthwatering jerky!

54.original: The key, you see, is to lay the meat strips in a well-lit area with cool, dry air. Good thing we're on top of a mountain, eh?

55.original: The Dawnservant himself once tasted my jerky many years ago. The Head of Resolve liked it so much, he wolfed it down in moments! <chuckle> I can still recall the Head of Reason's look of disgust. “Must you inhale it!?”

56.original: Ah, but this is no time to reminisce about the old days. There is work to be done, and this tulidile meat will make a scrumptious jerky with just the right amount of chew.

57.original: While you were hunting, I cooked you a little treat for later. Consider it your payment for replenishing my stock!
